name: What should buyers confirm before choosing a rigid gift box manufacturer?

mainEntity.name: What should buyers confirm before choosing a rigid gift box manufacturer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buyers reviewing a rigid gift box manufacturer should confirm the product dimensions, product weight, box structure, insert requirement, surface finish, artwork status and intended retail channel before sampling. MUGE PACKAGING can be evaluated for magnetic closure, drawer, book-style and two-piece rigid gift box projects.
